mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.task_no, t.task_type, t.status, t.warehouse_id, w.name AS warehouse_name, t.sku_id, p.sku_code, p.name AS sku_name, t.batch_no, t.from_location_id, fl.code AS from_location_code, t.to_location_id, tl.code AS to_location_code, t.plan_qty, t.actual_qty, t.assignee_id, t.assignee_name, t.source_type, t.source_id, t.source_no, t.priority, t.create_time, t.start_time, t.finish_time, t.remark FROM stock_task t LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON w.id = t.warehouse_id AND w.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN location fl ON fl.id = t.from_location_id LEFT JOIN location tl ON tl.id = t.to_location_id LEFT JOIN product p ON p.id = t.sku_id WHERE t.id = #{id} AND t.deleted = 0

SELECT l.id FROM location l LEFT JOIN inventory i ON i.location_id = l.id AND i.sku_id = #{skuId} AND i.deleted = 0 AND i.qty > 0 WHERE l.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND l.deleted = 0 AND l.status = 'ENABLED' AND l.location_type = 'RACK' GROUP BY l.id, l.capacity, l.used_capacity ORDER BY MAX(CASE WHEN i.id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC, CASE WHEN l.capacity = 0 THEN 999999 ELSE l.used_capacity / l.capacity END ASC, l.id ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT l.id FROM location l WHERE l.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND l.deleted = 0 AND l.location_type = 'TEMP' ORDER BY l.id ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE stock_task SET status = 'ASSIGNED', assignee_id = #{assigneeId}, assignee_name = #{assigneeName} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'CREATED' AND deleted = 0
UPDATE stock_task SET status = 'PROCESSING', start_time = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ASSIGNED' AND deleted = 0

UPDATE stock_task SET status = 'TIMEOUT', remark = CONCAT(LEFT(IFNULL(remark, ''), 200), ' [系统]超过截止时间自动标记超时') WHERE status IN ('CREATED', 'ASSIGNED', 'PROCESSING') AND deadline IS NOT NULL AND deadline < #{now} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT #{limit}

UPDATE stock_task SET status = 'CREATED', retry_count = retry_count + 1, assignee_id = NULL, assignee_name = NULL, start_time = NULL, deadline = #{newDeadline}, remark = CONCAT(LEFT(IFNULL(remark, ''), 200), ' [系统]已重新入池（最后一次机会）') WHERE status = 'TIMEOUT' AND retry_count < 1 AND deleted = 0 LIMIT #{limit}
